# Hopper

> Hopper is a travel booking platform specializing in hotel deals, flights, car rentals, and comprehensive travel comparison across major US destinations.

Hopper aggregates hotel listings, pricing, and reviews across hundreds of properties in top travel destinations. The platform emphasizes budget accommodations, price comparisons, and travel deals to help users find the best rates.

## Key Topics

- Hotel deals
- Budget hotels
- Price comparison
- Hotel search
- Travel booking
- Hotel reviews
- Hotel listings
- Travel deals
- Star ratings
- 4-star hotels
- Las Vegas
- Florida destinations
- Orlando
- New York City
- Budget accommodations

## Hotel Search & Booking

- [Hopper | Book Hotels, Flights, Car Rentals & More](https://hopper.com): Hopper homepage for booking hotels, flights, car rentals and travel deals
